['Carl Spaeter GmbH '].company_description: Carl Spaeter GmbH operates in Oberhausen, Germany, and is involved in the acquisition and operation of factories for the processing of mining and metallurgical products. The company also participates in social enterprises related to these activities. Additionally, it has a partnership agreement with Salzgitter Flachstahl GmbH for the delivery of green steel.

['Koenig & Bauer AG '].company_description: Koenig & Bauer AG is a German company that makes printing presses based in Würzburg. It was founded in 1817 and is the oldest printing press manufacturer in the world still in service. The company's division, Koenig & Bauer Banknote Solutions SA, is responsible for producing 95% of the banknotes used worldwide.
